verdict.rationale: The creating-llamafiles docs say a llamafile can bundle the executable, model weights, and a set of default arguments into one self-contained file, so a power-user could package a task-tuned configuration. However, nothing in the evidence describes assistant-level customization such as personas, system prompts, or task presets, so this support is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom assistant/persona or system-prompt configuration, task-specific preset management, examples of building specialized assistants, hands-on or independent corroboration.
